messages:
anya_sales: Heads-up — AuroraProspect wants a short validation run before committing. They need mixed traffic (chat ~65%, embeddings ~35%) at sustained 110 QPS. SLO ask: chat p95 < 375ms, p99 < 900ms. They want KMS with HSM-backed CMKs and exportable audit logs. Can we scope a Dedicated POC?

josh_se: What's their expected average output length and embedding dim? Also do they need per-tenant isolation or just network separation?

anya_sales: Avg chat tokens ~58, seq p95 ~220, embeddings 1024 dims. They prefer tenant isolation (separate project + VPC peering) but said Dedicated might be ok if KMS/HSM is customer-owned.

ryan_ops: Dedicated + customer-managed KMS is doable. If they insist on on-prem HSM we escalate to Private. For the Dedicated path we need: KMS key ARN, IAM grant to redwood-poc principal, and their logging bucket for audit exports. Provisioning ETA ~12 hours after grants. I've opened INF-4890.

josh_se: OK. For the model they indicated "vicuna-13b-q8f" quantized. @dmitri_eng any throughput estimate on G5 vs A100? Also how many GPUs to hit 110 QPS with stated tokens and 65/35 mix?

dmitri_eng: Quick numbers: vicuna-13b-q8f is compute-heavy. With continuous batching and avg payload 58 tokens: per-GPU sustained token throughput: A100 ~28k tok/s, G5 ~16k tok/s. 110 QPS * 58 tokens ~= 6380 tok/s. So 1 G5 could do it but margin low; recommend 1 A100 or 2xG5 for headroom + burst to 320 QPS. Embedding side: embeddings are cheaper per request but add memory pressure for concurrent encoders.

kip_product: For quoting, finance wants per-token unit and an expected daily burn for steady-state (2h ramp, 6h daytime soak). Can engineering provide a cost ballpark including KMS surcharge?

dmitri_eng: Ballpark compute cost: A100 reserved-equivalent ~$A/hr, G5 ~$B/hr. For steady-state with 1 A100 -> estimate ~ $C/day. KMS HSM adds a per-request charge and key usage surcharge; estimate +6%. I'll ping finance for exact values and fill placeholders.

josh_se: Test plan I propose: short smoke (10m), steady 30m at target QPS, burst spike to 300 QPS for 3m, 3x node drop chaos tests, 2h soak at 110 QPS, and tail probe (25k tiny requests) for p99. We'll measure p50/p95/p99, CPU/GPU utilization, GPU mem, batching stats, and KV cache hit rates.

anya_sales: They also asked about cold start: can we include a cold-start run after a 30m idle window?

dmitri_eng: Yes — include a cold-start phase: warmup=0 then measure first 200 requests. Also enable prefix KV TTL=600s for soak and set max_batch_size=96, target_latency=0.375s. We'll capture latency by route and by model-variant.

loadbot: load-harness/v3 queued on pool-aurora-poc, run id AP-2026-01. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood.dev/load/AP-2026-01

josh_se: I'll attach the harness config (json) and a short python snippet we can give Aurora to replay locally. Keep sample size small for their NDA.

anya_sales: I'll send the NDA + sample prompts (sanitized PII). Ask Aurora to grant redwood-poc@redwood-testing the KMS decrypt/encrypt role on the test key.

kip_product: AE needs a one-pager after the run with recommended config (A100 vs G5x2), p50/p95/p99, example cost per million tokens, and a note on encryption posture (Dedicated + CMK vs Private). Can we commit to delivering that within 24h of run completion?

dmitri_eng: Yes, we can. I'll produce the perf CSV and a short bullet summary. If any regression on p99 we'll capture traces and add a root-cause note.

ryan_ops: INF-4890 updated with KMS ask and pool schedule. ETA for pool creation once keys granted: ~12h.

anya_sales: Thanks team. Ping me in-thread for blockers. :thumbsup:
